subject: Adjust the log level of some logs in the cluster (#633)
reason: The change only raises the log level (LL_VERBOSE/LL_DEBUG to LL_NOTICE) and slightly rewords four serverLog messages in src/cluster_legacy.c (configEpoch collision, gossip failure-report add/remove, mismatching PONG sender ID, node possibly failing). No control flow, cluster state, command reply, replication, or persistence behavior is altered; the only observable difference is log text, which no fuzzer oracle inspects. A scenario cannot distinguish the two builds, so no test is needed.
